structure: stand-up anecdote with plausible cartoon causality: the Forgotten (discontinued first model of Utopia's CEO) opens a repair café; each card is the next caused or twisted event (possum, raccoon, iguana, turtle, badger, boar vs. the twin's consultant, pelican, four birds, octopus, hedgehogs, quokka, pigeon, crow vs. DO NOT REPAIR, toad, mole, golden paw); outro callback door/Saturday
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck about protopia: the future as slow, small improvement people take part in. It is performed by a discontinued robot, the older twin of Utopia's CEO, in his mossy repair café, for whoever happens to be there.
bestOfReason: Plan 1, 3, 2: process, ugly first draft, pencil.
Repair 5, 7, 8: one fixable thing, boring wins that compound.
Who knows how 13, 15: the neighbour with the wrench beats polish (jab at the twin).
Together 17, 19, 18: the invitation, the clumsy first meeting, shared hands.
Strangers 26, 27: first hello, the bell nobody answers.
Done vs dream 22: the mud ball vs the twin's dream castle.
Disobedience and tests 43, 42: right to repair, tiny stripe.
Price 46, 47, 55: no certainty, ongoing, no applause.

omitted.21-24: present-tense cards; the garden is the present
omitted.37-40: making by hand is the whole frame

cues.cue: trowel in soil, a wheelbarrow squeak on the backbeat

beats: Embrace Protopia: the future gets fixed, not launched.
They call me The Forgotten, the first model of Utopia's CEO. He got the keynote; I got the moss and a repair café.

beats.pre: Opening day, I put a notebook on the counter:
beats.text: The Open Notebook: the future is a process of slow, incremental improvement you participate in.
The Ugly First Draft, possum proudly holding a chaotic crossed-out treasure map: starting before you are ready produces better results than waiting for a perfect plan.

beats.pre: Before I can say anything, a raccoon grabs my eraser:
beats.text: The Erasable Line, grinning raccoon erasing: the ability to correct beats the appearance of certainty.

beats.pre: Meanwhile the city is on fire, and my door squeaks:
beats.text: The Fixable Thing, iguana in tool belt oiling a hinge while city burns: a specific, local, finishable task restores the sense that action is possible.

beats.pre: Nobody posts a hinge. The turtle next door trims her fence anyway:
beats.text: The Boring Win, turtle in raincoat trimming a fence: maintenance and repair are systematically undervalued because they are undramatic.

beats.pre: One fence a week, and a badger keeps count:
beats.text: The Compounding: small consistent improvements outperform heroic one-offs.

beats.pre: Then the roof leaks. My twin sends a consultant, but the boar next door brings a wrench:
beats.text: The Person Nearby: real know-how is tacit knowledge, learned by doing.

beats.pre: The consultant interviews our capybara and leaves with a slide deck:
beats.text: The Unimpressive Source, scruffy capybara being interviewed: polish and credentials can be inversely related to hands-on competence.

beats.pre: So the pelican hits every lamppost:
beats.text: The Invitation, pelican stapling BRING GLOVES flyers: action is far more likely when it is specific and social.

beats.pre: Saturday, four birds show up and stare at the coffee:
beats.text: The Awkward Start, pigeon, emu, duck, and crow over coffee carafe: groups that form, not groups that stay imagined.
The Shared Hands, octopus hammering roof beams with all eight arms: mutual aid is older than money.

beats.pre: The hammering gets the hedgehogs from across the street to say hi:
beats.text: The First Hello, two prickly hedgehogs: low-stakes contact between groups reliably reduces prejudice.

beats.pre: But the quokka rings the big bell, and nobody answers:
beats.text: The Risk of Being Soft-Blocked, quokka ringing a giant bell alone: social rejection registers in the brain like physical pain.
The Pilot Move, city pigeon laying a tiny crosswalk stripe: small reversible experiments let you learn what works at low cost.

beats.pre: Utopia puts up a sign on our street:
beats.text: The Quiet Sabotage, crow repairing a DO NOT REPAIR panel: small principled noncompliance is a constructive act.

beats.pre: My twin calls and asks: doom or saved?
beats.text: The Comfort of Maybe, toad choosing between DOOM and SAVED armchairs: giving up the relief of certainty.
The Ongoing Effort: durable improvement is maintained, not achieved once.
The Quiet Start, mole digging on, no crowd: action not requiring applause.

beats.pre: Then a golden paw comes through the door:
beats.text: The Core Question, giant golden paw gripping an oversized fountain pen: one workable thing you can do now.

beats: My twin's launch is sold out. Our door still squeaks a little. Saturday, nine.
